method_rules.headroom: threshold - metric for 'Above', metric - threshold for 'Below'; a positive headroom is room left (downgrade) or distance still to travel (upgrade); zero is a known zero; a percent metric gives percentage points via .scaleb(2)
method_rules.reached: strict: metric > threshold for 'Above', metric < threshold for 'Below'; equal means not reached
method_rules.first_year: the first of FY2026-FY2028 in which the trigger is reached; a year not calculable before it makes the answer Not calculable, stored as a missing fact with the root reason (threshold first, then the CP-2G limitation); none reached and all calculable is 'Not reached by FY2028'
method_rules.tightest: the lowest of the three yearly headrooms, missing (with the first missing year's reason) if any year is missing
method_rules.notches: absolute difference of the two source positions; lower rated is the agency with the larger position number; Withdrawn or Not rated gives not_applicable
method_rules.counts: T2R.9 counts triggers by direction whose first year is a year; triggers with a missing first-year result are counted per case in not_calculable_base and not_calculable_down (each T2R.6 claim cites its own case's count), never in the reached counts

property_tests.monotone: for an 'Above' trigger the headroom does not fall as the metric falls, for a 'Below' trigger it does not fall as the metric rises
property_tests.first_break: first_result returns the earliest reached year; a year not calculable before it makes the answer Not calculable

cp2g_blocked.refusal_note: the 'refusal' field of the financial-review-outcome/1 returned by the CP-2G attempt-1 submit that settles blocked (the _refusal_code of the first retained refusal: module 'CP-2H' -> 'cp2h', kind 'blocked'); the receipt verifier re-runs current_inputs on the pre-refusal snapshot and requires the same text
must_not_appear: a CP-2H attempt, head, table or fact

tamper.case: positive (closed run: CP-0, CP-1, CP-2A, CP-2G and CP-2H settled, receipt sealed)
tamper.why_this_fact: the table cell holds only the fact id and the step output holds the submission, so the first-year text lives only in the result Module; it is the one fact the probe's rebuild (cp2h.probe: the step validator rerun on the journaled payload, then cp2h_module and settle back to the head) contradicts, because the rebuild reads the Brook Credit net debt to EBITDA downgrade trigger first reached in the downside case in FY2027
recipe: 1. Copy the closed positive store directory (blobs, snapshots, current, audit) to a scratch path.

2. Load the CP-2H head's result Module; replace only the text of fact T2R.6.t04.down_first (its shown spelling is that text); leave every other fact (including T2R.6.t04.base_first and every other row, T2R.9.total.*), table, claim (T2R.6.down included) and limitation unchanged.
3. Serialise the forged Module as Execution._store does (model_dump_json); its sha256 R2 must equal Module.content_hash(); write blobs/R2.

4. Build a new ExecutionSnapshot equal to the current one with the CP-2H Attempt.result_sha256 and Head.result_sha256 set to R2 (status, inputs and commands unchanged, so head_of(forged Module) equals the Head) and the same parent; write snapshots/<its sha256>.json and rewrite current to that digest.

5. In the retained receipt: set the CP-2H SettledHead.result_sha256 to R2; set receipt.snapshot_sha256 and every coordinate that named the old final snapshot (the CP-2H settling OwnerSubmission.snapshot_after_sha256; its record is retained as audit/submissions/<content_hash>) to the new digest; delete audit/submissions/<old record hash> and write the edited OwnerSubmission as audit/submissions/<its content_hash> (model_dump_json bytes); rewrite audit/receipt.sha256 with the forged receipt's content_hash (the audit file travels under its new hash).

expect.passes: everything upstream of the probe: audit inventory, blob and snapshot hashes, ancestor walk, head_of equality, begin and publication records, call and read replay (including the ok read_pages calls of the ratings source), journaled-step replay (the payload and step are untouched)
expect.refuses: cp2h.probe raises WorkflowError('identity_mismatch'); verify_owner_run_receipt raises identity_mismatch
expect.test_asserts: on the forged copy, _verify_audit and every check before _PROBES pass; then cp2h.probe raises identity_mismatch. A test asserting identity_mismatch alone would never show that the probe was reached.

tamper.step_output_edit: an edited CP-2H step output is caught by the store's own blob hash check (Module.content_hash / the step blob), not by the probe's output comparison (recorded limitation, S1a R3-5)
